report.summary: D24 correction 1/1 for PLAY04. Fixed drawQuayWater vertical branch numeric coordinates: right coping x and both vertical joint endpoints used the water object w (yielding strings like 450[object Object]1) and now use numeric w.w; no other scene expressions, materials or geometry changed. Strengthened the Canvas recorder in test-street-atmosphere.js: per-operation finite-numeric argument validation (fillText/strokeText keep a string first arg; addColorStop keeps string color; styles/dashes/gradients accepted), a negative harness self-test for string/undefined/NaN/Infinity geometry, correct Canvas post-multiplication scale (x column a,b by sx; y column c,d by sy; translation e,f unchanged) with independent translate(10,20)+scale(2,3)->[2,0,0,3,10,20] and world (4,5)->screen (18,35) checks plus nested save/restore, and a strengthened inverse test comparing the actual recorded world-space draw matrix (from the base land rect) with scene.cityTransform and cityWorldPoint at pub, Lotte, bridge 516,624 and map edges in street/overview/overview-zoom2. Red first: strengthened tests against the uncorrected scene failed 5/7 with 'fillRect requires finite numeric geometry at argument 0 but got 450[object Object]1' at drawQuayWater line 72; the two pure recorder tests passed. Green after the one-file numeric fix: 7/7. Original five behavior tests and intent preserved; test-city.js untouched.

tests.summary: RED before scene fix (harness already strengthened), exit 1: 2 pass / 5 fail; every city render aborted with 'fillRect requires finite numeric geometry at argument 0 but got 450[object Object]1' at drawQuayWater vertical right coping (reopening-scene.js line 72 via drawCity line 152); both new pure-recorder tests passed, showing the red is the scene defect.

GREEN after numeric quay fix, exit 0: 7/7 pass - original 5 behavior tests (reduced-motion frame equality, ambient animation, input/city immutability, finite coords and balanced transforms, inverse mapping) preserved plus recorder post-multiplication/nested save-restore and negative geometry-rejection self-test.
Exit 0: immutable city suite passes, 13/13 (contract, frozen geometry, 49 routes, ferry corridor, movement/restore, camera transform tests).
Exit 0: syntax check passes with no output.
